title: Pudhu Pettai
desc: A young boy runs away when his mother dies and ends up in the company of a gangster. He soon becomes the right-hand man of his employer and makes dangerous enemies.

title: Eera Nilam
desc: A woman's sons go to the Kargil war and get martyred. Later, the younger son takes the responsibility of supporting his family.

title: Medhai
desc: A school teacher, wrongly accused of embezzling money from a public trust, sets out on a path of revenge after learning about the events that led to his imprisonment.

title: Idhayathai Thirudathe
desc: A terminally ill man decides to live alone on a hill station and falls for a bubbly woman, until he makes a shocking discovery.

title: Mr. Madras
desc: An industrialist hires a young man to settle her disputes with a local criminal on her behalf.
